question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Anchor: NVIDIA's sequential GAAP opex guides this year rose 7.7->8.5->9.2 (+8-10%/qtr); last two years' Q4 guide stepped up 12-15% vs Q3 guide/actual. Full-year cross-check: CFO guided FY27 opex growth 'low 50s' (raised from upper 40s) on FY26 GAAP opex $23.08B -> ~$34.9-35.5B; YTD Q1 7.62 + Q2 8.41 + Q3 ~9.1 (actuals run slightly under guide) implies Q4 ~9.7-10.4, centered ~10.0-10.1. Upside risk: another raise of the FY growth range or acquisition-related GAAP items; downside: Q3 overspend absorbing the budget. No human prediction market found (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi none).
